Package io.github.projectunified.valuevenue.core

Interface ValueSource<K,SV>

Type Parameters:
K - type of the key
SV - type of the source value
All Superinterfaces:
Function<K,List<SV>>
All Known Implementing Classes:
BukkitPlayerSource, DynamicNumberValueSource, EnumValueSource, KeyValueSource, NumberValueSource, SimpleValueSource, StringSplitSource
public interface ValueSource<K,SV> extends Function<K,List<SV>>
The source values a value generator works on, before they are turned into final values.

A generator caches one final value per source value, so the source values are the identity of what is generated. They can depend on the key or be shared by every key.

It is a Function from a key to the active source values of that key, so it can be handed to a ValueVenue as it is.
